description: Read-only operational view of an Azure Service Bus namespace (Azure Monitor platform metrics). Modernized from grafana.com dashboard 10533.

links.title: Service Bus metrics reference
links.tooltip: Microsoft Learn: supported metrics for Microsoft.ServiceBus/namespaces

links.title: Open namespace in Azure portal
links.tooltip: Navigation only: opens the namespace overview in the Azure portal

panels.title: Active messages (now)
panels.description: Messages waiting to be processed, summed across all entities of the namespace. Computed as the latest non-null 1-minute value of each entity, then summed, so an entity whose last minute has not arrived yet still counts. Always queried over the last 30 minutes at a 1-minute grain, independent of the dashboard time range. Split by the EntityName dimension, limited to the top 50 entities returned by Azure Monitor. Microsoft documents that while a namespace is throttled, message counts can be reported as 0.

panels.title: Dead-lettered messages (now)
panels.description: Messages in dead-letter subqueues, summed across all entities. Any value above 0 needs attention. Computed as the latest non-null 1-minute value of each entity, then summed, so an entity whose last minute has not arrived yet still counts. Always queried over the last 30 minutes at a 1-minute grain, independent of the dashboard time range. Split by the EntityName dimension, limited to the top 50 entities returned by Azure Monitor.

panels.title: Incoming messages (range)
panels.description: Total messages sent to the namespace during the selected time range (includes auto-forwarded messages).

panels.title: Outgoing messages (range)
panels.description: Total messages delivered from the namespace during the selected time range (excludes auto-forwarded messages).

panels.title: Server errors (range)
panels.description: Requests not processed because of an error in the Service Bus service during the selected time range.

panels.title: Throttled requests (range)
panels.description: Requests throttled during the selected time range. See 'Throttled requests by reason' for the cause.

panels.title: Scheduled messages (now)
panels.description: Scheduled messages, summed across all entities. Computed as the latest non-null 1-minute value of each entity, then summed, so an entity whose last minute has not arrived yet still counts. Always queried over the last 30 minutes at a 1-minute grain, independent of the dashboard time range. Split by the EntityName dimension, limited to the top 50 entities returned by Azure Monitor.

panels.title: Entity size (now)
panels.description: Storage used by all entities, summed across entities. Computed as the latest non-null 1-minute value of each entity, then summed, so an entity whose last minute has not arrived yet still counts. Always queried over the last 30 minutes at a 1-minute grain, independent of the dashboard time range. Split by the EntityName dimension, limited to the top 50 entities returned by Azure Monitor.

panels.title: Active connections (now)
panels.description: Active connections on the namespace (latest value, always over the last 30 minutes). Queried at a fixed 1-minute grain because the only supported aggregation is Total, which would add samples together at coarser grains.

panels.title: Successful requests (range)
panels.description: Successful requests during the selected time range.

panels.title: User errors (range)
panels.description: Requests not processed because of client-side errors (for example lock lost, invalid operations) during the selected time range.

panels.title: Server send latency (avg)
panels.description: Average latency of send operations over the selected time range (mean of the per-grain averages).

panels.title: Messages in / out (namespace)
panels.description: Incoming vs outgoing messages for the whole namespace. Counter metric (Total): each point is the count accumulated during one Azure Monitor time grain (auto-selected from the time range, minimum 1 minute), not a per-second rate. The two series can legitimately differ (filters, duplicate detection, TTL expiry, dead-lettering, auto-forwarding).

panels.title: Requests (namespace)
panels.description: Incoming, successful and throttled requests for the whole namespace. Counter metric (Total): each point is the count accumulated during one Azure Monitor time grain (auto-selected from the time range, minimum 1 minute), not a per-second rate.

panels.title: Data volume (namespace)
panels.description: Bytes sent to and delivered from the namespace. Counter metric (Total): each point is the bytes accumulated during one Azure Monitor time grain (auto-selected from the time range, minimum 1 minute), not a per-second rate.

panels.title: Server send latency
panels.description: Average latency of send operations, in milliseconds.

panels.title: Active messages by entity
panels.description: Backlog per queue/topic/subscription entity. Point-in-time metric sampled every minute; each point is the average of the samples in the time grain. Split by the EntityName dimension, limited to the top 50 entities returned by Azure Monitor. Microsoft documents that while a namespace is throttled, message counts can be reported as 0. Legend sorted by latest value.

panels.title: Dead-lettered messages by entity
panels.description: Dead-letter subqueue depth per entity. Point-in-time metric sampled every minute; each point is the average of the samples in the time grain. Split by the EntityName dimension, limited to the top 50 entities returned by Azure Monitor. Legend sorted by latest value.

panels.title: Incoming messages by entity
panels.description: Messages sent per entity. Counter metric (Total): each point is the count accumulated during one Azure Monitor time grain (auto-selected from the time range, minimum 1 minute), not a per-second rate. Split by the EntityName dimension, limited to the top 50 entities returned by Azure Monitor.

panels.title: Outgoing messages by entity
panels.description: Messages delivered per entity. Counter metric (Total): each point is the count accumulated during one Azure Monitor time grain (auto-selected from the time range, minimum 1 minute), not a per-second rate. Split by the EntityName dimension, limited to the top 50 entities returned by Azure Monitor.

panels.title: Entity size
panels.description: Storage used per entity, in bytes. Point-in-time metric sampled every minute; each point is the average of the samples in the time grain. Split by the EntityName dimension, limited to the top 50 entities returned by Azure Monitor.

panels.title: Scheduled messages by entity
panels.description: Scheduled messages per entity. Point-in-time metric sampled every minute; each point is the average of the samples in the time grain. Split by the EntityName dimension, limited to the top 50 entities returned by Azure Monitor.

panels.title: Abandoned messages by entity
panels.description: Messages abandoned by receivers per entity (lock released without completing). A steady stream usually means a consumer keeps failing on the same messages, which then move to the dead-letter queue after MaxDeliveryCount attempts. Counter metric (Total): each point is the count accumulated during one Azure Monitor time grain (auto-selected from the time range, minimum 1 minute), not a per-second rate. Split by the EntityName dimension, limited to the top 50 entities returned by Azure Monitor.

panels.title: Errors (namespace)
panels.description: Server errors (Service Bus side) and user errors (client side) for the whole namespace. Counter metric (Total): each point is the count accumulated during one Azure Monitor time grain (auto-selected from the time range, minimum 1 minute), not a per-second rate.

panels.title: Throttled requests by reason
panels.description: Throttled requests split by the MessagingErrorSubCode dimension (documented values: CPU, Storage, Namespace, Unknown). Counter metric (Total): each point is the count accumulated during one Azure Monitor time grain (auto-selected from the time range, minimum 1 minute), not a per-second rate.

panels.title: Active connections
panels.description: Active connections on the namespace at a fixed 1-minute grain (Total is the only supported aggregation; a coarser grain would add samples together). Long time ranges therefore return many points.

panels.title: CPU usage (Premium)
panels.description: Namespace CPU usage per replica. Premium tier only; Basic/Standard namespaces return no data. Replaces the deprecated CPUXNS metric.

panels.title: Memory usage (Premium)
panels.description: Namespace memory usage per replica. Premium tier only; Basic/Standard namespaces return no data. Replaces the deprecated WSXNS metric.
